pl_name.name: pl_name
pl_name.description: Planet name as listed in the NASA Exoplanet Archive. Typically formatted as '<star> <letter>' (e.g. TRAPPIST-1 e, Kepler-186 f).

pl_letter.name: pl_letter
pl_letter.description: Planet letter suffix (b, c, d, e, etc.) assigned in order of discovery.

pl_controv_flag.name: pl_controv_flag
pl_controv_flag.description: Controversy flag: 1 = planet confirmation is debated/questioned in literature; 0 = confirmed.

tran_flag.name: tran_flag
tran_flag.description: Transit flag: 1 = planet transits its host star as observed from Earth; 0 = no transit detected.

rv_flag.name: rv_flag
rv_flag.description: Radial velocity flag: 1 = planet detected via Doppler/RV spectroscopy; 0 = not detected via RV.

ttv_flag.name: ttv_flag
ttv_flag.description: Transit Timing Variation flag: 1 = timing variations confirmed; 0 = no confirmed TTVs.

ptv_flag.name: ptv_flag
ptv_flag.description: Planet Transit Timing Variations flag: 1 = timing variations detected in planetary transits.

ast_flag.name: ast_flag
ast_flag.description: Astrometry flag: 1 = planet detected via astrometric wobble of the host star.

micro_flag.name: micro_flag
micro_flag.description: Microlensing flag: 1 = planet detected via gravitational microlensing.

ima_flag.name: ima_flag
ima_flag.description: Direct imaging flag: 1 = planet detected via direct optical/infrared imaging.

pl_orbper.name: pl_orbper
pl_orbper.description: Orbital period: the time required for the planet to complete one full revolution around its star.

pl_orbsmax.name: pl_orbsmax
pl_orbsmax.description: Semi-major axis: the longest semi-diameter of the planet's elliptical orbit.

pl_orbeccen.name: pl_orbeccen
pl_orbeccen.description: Orbital eccentricity: deviation of the orbit from a perfect circle (0 = circular, 0 < e < 1 = elliptical).

pl_orbincl.name: pl_orbincl
pl_orbincl.description: Orbital inclination: angle of the orbital plane relative to the plane of the sky (90 deg = edge-on).

pl_orblper.name: pl_orblper
pl_orblper.description: Longitude / argument of periastron: angular distance of the periastron from the ascending node.

pl_orbtper.name: pl_orbtper
pl_orbtper.description: Time of periastron passage: Barycentric Julian Date at closest approach.

pl_orbtper_systemref.name: pl_orbtper_systemref
pl_orbtper_systemref.description: Time reference system used for the periastron passage ephemeris (e.g. BJD_TDB).

pl_rade.name: pl_rade
pl_rade.description: Planet equatorial radius measured in Earth radii (1 R_Earth = 6,378.137 km).

pl_radj.name: pl_radj
pl_radj.description: Planet equatorial radius measured in Jupiter radii (1 R_Jupiter = 71,492 km).

pl_masse.name: pl_masse
pl_masse.description: Planet mass measured in Earth masses (1 M_Earth = 5.9722 x 10^24 kg).

pl_massj.name: pl_massj
pl_massj.description: Planet mass measured in Jupiter masses (1 M_Jupiter = 1.89813 x 10^27 kg = 317.8 M_Earth).

pl_bmasse.name: pl_bmasse
pl_bmasse.description: Best-estimate planet mass in Earth masses (true mass or m*sin(i) lower limit).

pl_bmassj.name: pl_bmassj
pl_bmassj.description: Best-estimate planet mass in Jupiter masses (true mass or m*sin(i) lower limit).

pl_bmassprov.name: pl_bmassprov
pl_bmassprov.description: Provenance of the best-estimate mass: 'Mass' (true mass), 'Msini' (minimum mass), etc.

pl_msinie.name: pl_msinie
pl_msinie.description: Minimum mass (m * sin(i)) in Earth masses derived from radial velocity measurements.

pl_msinij.name: pl_msinij
pl_msinij.description: Minimum mass (m * sin(i)) in Jupiter masses derived from radial velocity measurements.

pl_dens.name: pl_dens
pl_dens.description: Mean bulk density of the planet computed from mass and radius.

pl_eqt.name: pl_eqt
pl_eqt.description: Equilibrium temperature: blackbody surface temperature assuming uniform heat redistribution and zero albedo.

pl_insol.name: pl_insol
pl_insol.description: Insolation flux: stellar irradiance received at the top of the atmosphere relative to Earth solar flux.

pl_trandur.name: pl_trandur
pl_trandur.description: Transit duration: total elapsed time from transit ingress to egress.

pl_trandep.name: pl_trandep
pl_trandep.description: Transit depth: percentage decrease in stellar flux during mid-transit.

pl_tranmid.name: pl_tranmid
pl_tranmid.description: Transit mid-point epoch in Barycentric Julian Date.

pl_tranmid_systemref.name: pl_tranmid_systemref
pl_tranmid_systemref.description: Time standard reference for the transit midpoint (e.g. BJD_TDB).

pl_ratror.name: pl_ratror
pl_ratror.description: Ratio of planet radius to stellar radius (Rp / R_star).

pl_ratdor.name: pl_ratdor
pl_ratdor.description: Ratio of orbital semi-major axis to stellar radius (a / R_star).

pl_imppar.name: pl_imppar
pl_imppar.description: Impact parameter (b): projected distance between planet and stellar centers at transit center in stellar radii.

pl_occdep.name: pl_occdep
pl_occdep.description: Occultation / secondary eclipse depth: fractional brightness decrease when planet passes behind the host star.

pl_rvamp.name: pl_rvamp
pl_rvamp.description: Radial velocity semi-amplitude (K) induced on the host star by the orbiting planet.

pl_projobliq.name: pl_projobliq
pl_projobliq.description: Projected sky obliquity (lambda): angle between stellar spin axis and planetary orbital axis.

pl_trueobliq.name: pl_trueobliq
pl_trueobliq.description: True 3D stellar obliquity (psi): true angle between stellar spin and orbital angular momentum vectors.

pl_angsep.name: pl_angsep
pl_angsep.description: Angular separation between planet and host star on the plane of the sky.

pl_nespec.name: pl_nespec
pl_nespec.description: Number of emission / secondary eclipse spectra available in the archive.

pl_ntranspec.name: pl_ntranspec
pl_ntranspec.description: Number of transmission spectra available in the archive.

pl_ndispec.name: pl_ndispec
pl_ndispec.description: Number of direct-imaging spectra available in the archive.

pl_pubdate.name: pl_pubdate
pl_pubdate.description: Publication date of the planet's reference parameters (YYYY-MM).

hostname.name: hostname
hostname.description: Canonical primary name of the host star.

hd_name.name: hd_name
hd_name.description: Henry Draper Catalog identifier for the host star.

hip_name.name: hip_name
hip_name.description: Hipparcos Catalog identifier for the host star.

tic_id.name: tic_id
tic_id.description: TESS Input Catalog (TIC) source identifier for the host star.

gaia_dr2_id.name: gaia_dr2_id
gaia_dr2_id.description: Gaia Data Release 2 (DR2) source identifier for the host star.

gaia_dr3_id.name: gaia_dr3_id
gaia_dr3_id.description: Gaia Data Release 3 (DR3) source identifier for the host star.

st_spectype.name: st_spectype
st_spectype.description: Stellar spectral classification (e.g. G2V, M3.5V, K1IV).

st_rad.name: st_rad
st_rad.description: Stellar photospheric radius in solar radii (1 R_Sun = 695,700 km).

st_mass.name: st_mass
st_mass.description: Stellar mass in solar masses (1 M_Sun = 1.98847 x 10^30 kg).

st_met.name: st_met
st_met.description: Stellar metallicity [Fe/H]: logarithmic ratio of iron-to-hydrogen relative to the Sun.

st_logg.name: st_logg
st_logg.description: Stellar surface gravity in base-10 logarithmic cgs units (log10(cm/s²)).

st_lum.name: st_lum
st_lum.description: Stellar bolometric luminosity in base-10 logarithmic solar luminosities (log10(L_Sun)).

st_age.name: st_age
st_age.description: Estimated stellar age since zero-age main sequence (ZAMS).

st_dens.name: st_dens
st_dens.description: Mean bulk density of the host star.

st_radv.name: st_radv
st_radv.description: Systemic heliocentric radial velocity of the host star.

st_log_rhk.name: st_log_rhk
st_log_rhk.description: Chromospheric activity index log10(R'_HK) derived from Ca II H & K lines.

st_nphot.name: st_nphot
st_nphot.description: Number of photometric time-series records available for this star in the archive.

st_nrvc.name: st_nrvc
st_nrvc.description: Number of radial velocity time-series records available for this star.

st_nspec.name: st_nspec
st_nspec.description: Number of stellar spectra available in the archive.

sy_name.name: sy_name
sy_name.description: System designation (usually matches hostname or discovery system name).

ra.name: ra
ra.description: Right Ascension of the system in decimal degrees (ICRS J2000 epoch).

dec.name: dec
dec.description: Declination of the system in decimal degrees (ICRS J2000 epoch).

sy_dist.name: sy_dist
sy_dist.description: Distance from the Solar System to the planetary system.

sy_plx.name: sy_plx
sy_plx.description: Trigonometric parallax of the host star measured by Gaia/Hipparcos.

sy_pm.name: sy_pm
sy_pm.description: Total proper motion vector magnitude on the celestial sphere.

sy_pmra.name: sy_pmra
sy_pmra.description: Proper motion in Right Ascension (pmRA * cos(Dec)).

sy_snum.name: sy_snum
sy_snum.description: Total number of confirmed stars in the planetary system.

sy_pnum.name: sy_pnum
sy_pnum.description: Total number of confirmed planets in the planetary system.

sy_mnum.name: sy_mnum
sy_mnum.description: Total number of confirmed moons in the planetary system.

cb_flag.name: cb_flag
cb_flag.description: Circumbinary flag: 1 = planet orbits two or more stars (P-type orbit); 0 = single star host.

sy_gaiamag.name: sy_gaiamag
sy_gaiamag.description: Gaia G-band broad apparent optical magnitude (~330-1050 nm).

sy_w1mag.name: sy_w1mag
sy_w1mag.description: WISE W1 band mid-infrared apparent magnitude (~3.4 µm).

sy_w2mag.name: sy_w2mag
sy_w2mag.description: WISE W2 band mid-infrared apparent magnitude (~4.6 µm).

sy_w3mag.name: sy_w3mag
sy_w3mag.description: WISE W3 band mid-infrared apparent magnitude (~12 µm).

sy_w4mag.name: sy_w4mag
sy_w4mag.description: WISE W4 band mid-infrared apparent magnitude (~22 µm).

discoverymethod.name: discoverymethod
discoverymethod.description: Primary detection technique (e.g. Transit, Radial Velocity, Microlensing, Direct Imaging).

disc_year.name: disc_year
disc_year.description: Year in which the planet was published as a confirmed exoplanet.

disc_facility.name: disc_facility
disc_facility.description: Observatory, space telescope mission, or survey facility that discovered the planet.

disc_instrument.name: disc_instrument
disc_instrument.description: Primary astronomical instrument / spectrograph / camera used for discovery.

disc_refname.name: disc_refname
disc_refname.description: Bibliographical ADS reference string for the discovery paper.
